name: Le Beautique Aesthetic Clinic and Laser Center, Krabi เลอบิวทีคคลินิก ความงามและเลเซอร์ จ.กระบี่

summary_en: Le Beautique Aesthetic Clinic and Laser Center in Bangkok specializes in facial treatments and laser procedures performed by medical professionals. The clinic holds a 4.7 rating based on 4 total reviews and maintains a trust score of 54.2.
